app_accessibility.code:
for setting, value in device.accessibility().items():
    print(setting, value)

app_cookies.code:
for cookie in device.cookies():
    print(cookie["name"], cookie["value"])

app_crashes.code:
for crash in device.crashes(app="com.example.shop"):
    print(crash["time"], crash["kind"], crash["summary"])

app_devices.code:
for info in device.devices():
    print(info.id, info.platform, info.state)

app_download.code:
saved = device.download("mobium-report.txt", path="report.txt")
print(saved["path"], saved["bytes"])

# Or the file itself, as bytes
report = device.download("mobium-report.txt")

for f in device.downloads():
    print(f["name"], f["bytes"])

app_find.code:
for el in device.find("role=button"):
    print(el.ref, el.label)

app_list_apps.code:
for app in device.apps():
    print(app["id"], app["version"])

app_map.code:
for el in device.map():
    print(el.ref, el.label)

app_source.code:
source = device.source()
with open("screen.xml", "w") as f:
    print(source["source"], file=f)

app_storage.code:
import json

with open("state.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(device.storage(), f)

connect.title: Connect without opening a session first
connect.code:
import mobium

device = mobium.connect()
print(device.current())
device.close()

connect.title: Pick one of several devices, with a daemon of its own
connect.code:
from mobium import connect

device = connect(device="emulator-5554", session="pixel")

close.title: Close the connection and leave the session open
close.code:
device = mobium.connect()
try:
    print(device.current())
finally:
    device.close()

Element.code:
for el in device.map():
    print(el.ref, el.label, el.role, el.locator, el.checked)

Bounds.title: Find where an element is on screen

DeviceInfo.title: Tell emulators from real hardware

MobiumError.title: Catch any failure, and read its code and remedy

NoSuchElementError.title: Scroll for an element that is not on screen

AmbiguousLocatorError.title: Fall back to a ref when a locator matches more than one element

TimedOutError.title: Handle a wait that never came true

UnsupportedError.title: Skip what a platform cannot do

NoDeviceError.title: Report that no device is running

DeviceNotReadyError.title: Unlock a device that is not ready

NotConfirmedError.title: Notice an action the device did not confirm

NoSuchContextError.title: Handle a WebView that is not there

NoSuchAlertError.title: Answer a dialog only if one is up

ElementNotReachableError.title: Handle an element that exists but cannot be touched

InvalidArgumentError.title: Catch an argument the tool refused

ToolchainMissingError.title: Point at doctor when a tool is missing

DeviceServerError.title: Read the device server's own code

InternalError.title: Retry only what can succeed again

answer_alert.title: Fill a prompt's field and accept it, in one call

intro.code:
from mobium import start

with start(platform="android", app="com.android.settings") as device:
    for el in device.map():
        print(el.ref, el.label)
intro.note: `device` below is what `start()` or `connect()` returned: a `mobium.Device`.
